answer: Each identity posts a sealed commitment — a hash of its next work plan — before the epoch beacon, then reveals the plan when the beacon fires. A clone farm cannot pre-write 200 distinct plans, so copied reveals expose it: any cluster where over 40% of commits share one bridge of identical text is frozen and every 1,000 POA bond locked 45 days is slashed 100%. Forging 200 fakes costs 200,000 POA parked plus 200 plans. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 reveals crossed same shale ledge of copied wording within 90 seconds, leaving no haven for its sponsors.
